physicalNotes: Radius 0.843 +/- 0.005 solar radii from Piotto et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-561 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.535.2763P/abstract): 586,475 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.806 +/- 0.036 solar masses from Piotto et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-561 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.535.2763P/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5342 +/- 57 K from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of TOI-561 b's parameter set from MacDougall et al. 2023 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
